record.one_liner: AI-native CRM/relationship-intelligence platform with a REST API, webhooks, and a hosted MCP server for workspace data.
record.auth_notes: REST API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (apps registered at build.attio.com, exchange code for a Bearer access_token) or a workspace API key for single-workspace apps. The hosted MCP server uses OAuth login to the user's Attio account and explicitly does not use API keys.
record.access_notes: Attio's pricing page states 'API and webhook access' is included on all plans including the free tier (no credit card required to sign up). Note: the same pricing page also lists 'MCP server' as a Pro/Enterprise-plan feature, so MCP access specifically may require a paid plan even though core REST API access is free.
record.api_breadth_basis: Vendor docs overview describes a REST API for reading/writing workspace data plus separate documented capabilities for webhooks, rate limiting, and filtering/sorting/pagination, indicating multiple resource families beyond a single narrow endpoint, though a full endpoint enumeration was not retrieved within budget.
record.blocker_notes: Free tier includes self-serve REST API and webhook access with no credit card required; OAuth app registration via build.attio.com appears self-serve with no stated approval process. MCP server access may require Pro/Enterprise plan per the pricing page.

evidence.quote: An access token for the workspace which can be used to make authenticated requests to the Attio REST API
you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required
